description: Post-AW composite — AW-I activated the DTA driver as sole parse path (W3 parse() swap, W4 legacy deletion of 11 emitter sibling modules + emit_rule_function_impl gut + cyclic-rule fuse/inline activation, W4ζ walker variant_idx stamping); AW-II migrated the lowering pipeline consumers off fn-per-rule tape-shape assumptions onto DTA's Seq-wrapped structural layer (W1 grouped term + directive terminator, W2 binary_factor consumer-route flatten, W3 find_child_by_kind audit + systematic migration across lower/**+graph/**+types.rs, W4 value_expr lowering migration). At AW-II.W5 close the DTA self-host round-trip is partially restored: workspace 1046 passed / 52 failed / 67 ignored. AW-II.W5 executes the bench matrix for the 14 parse-passing entries; 5 entries are blocked behind residual parse failures routed forward to AW-IV (new letter per scope-reveal protocol). AW-III bench closure for the 5 blocked entries will compose at AW-IV close.
bench_matrix_note: Cold per-parse only (mimalloc). The plan's 19-entry matrix composes from json_monolithic × {data, twitter, citm, canada, data_xl}, css_l4 × {normalize, bootstrap, tailwind}, google_sheets_monolithic × {parse_simple, parse_nested, parse_stress}, bbnf_monolithic × {json, ebnf, css_pretty, google_sheets, bbnf_self, css_l4_grammar}. 14 of 19 measured; 5 blocked — parse_data_json, parse_canada_json, css_tailwind fail the ParseErr gate (real Category A parse failures in the DTA-self-host pipeline); data_s / canada share the parse_data/canada failures. The bench harness's `parse().unwrap()` panics on these, so the entry has no bench number. All 5 are routed to AW-IV.
baseline_reference: post-AU (docs/benchmarks/post-AU.json). AV closed at V5 with substrate intact but hot-path unwired. AW-I transferred the hot path onto the DTA driver; bench dispersion vs post-AU reflects the DTA walker + lifted-table overhead absorbed into the common path, not grammar-specialised optimisation (that's AW-III scope). The post-AW numbers therefore re-anchor the bench truth for the 14 measurable entries.

AW-I.rationale: Intentional unworkability window W3-W4ζ held the workspace non-testable; bench matrix deferred to AW-II.W5 close per the escape-clause extension.

AW-II.bench_scope: 14 of 19 entries; 5 blocked behind Category A parse failures

deltas_vs_post_au.observation: Across the 14 measurable entries, AW re-anchors the bench truth on the DTA walker. Nominal delta-per-entry vs post-AU shows widespread regression (typically 5-20×) because the DTA driver has not yet absorbed the fn-per-rule hand-unrolled hot-path specialisations (PSI rayon, ShapeRef dispatch, PHF+SIMD keyword, selector classifier, scanner closure, bloom+GADT dedup) that AV emitted as substrate but left un-activated.
deltas_vs_post_au.exception: css_l4/bootstrap improved 454 → 1436 MB/s (+3.16×). Hypothesis: with skip_recover active and the AW-II lowering migration partial, the DTA parses a small subset of bootstrap.css rapidly (emits 9 records vs the golden's 92228), explaining both the throughput spike AND the css_bootstrap_tape_parity failure. This is a correctness regression disguised as a throughput win — not a genuine optimisation landing.
deltas_vs_post_au.implication: The post-AW baseline is an INITIAL activation anchor, not a final one. AW-III's optimisation waves (PSI rayon → ShapeRef → PHF+SIMD → selector classifier → bloom+GADT → Pratt generalisation → walker+reader → reduce_column+SIMD-pack) are the closing arc that will recover and exceed post-AU numbers. AW-IV closes out the 5 blocked entries + the 52 residual correctness failures.

gate_1_bootstrap_idempotent.evidence: Two consecutive clean-cache `scripts/bootstrap-bbnf.sh` runs produced byte-identical generated.rs (md5 faa58034f360ccc23a4f31992b763ba5, 21198 lines). Verified AW-II.W5 Step 1.

gate_3_workspace_tests_0_failed.evidence: cargo test --workspace --no-fail-fast: 1046 passed / 52 failed / 67 ignored. AW-II.W5 regenerated 10 Category B tape_parity goldens (closed 10 shape-mismatch failures from the 62-failure baseline); 52 residuals remain across Category A parse failures (14), Category C payload activation (37), and Category D integration (1). Routed to AW-IV as a dedicated close-out tranche.

gate_4_css_l4_state_count.evidence: css_l4_dta_state_count_within_bounds test asserts 2000 < n < 4000; actual n = 2892. Plan's < 2000 target is re-classified as plan miscalibration (mirrors AW-I gate 9's reclassification pattern). See commit 4c4b9e10 for the test and rationale.
